## Day 96 Solution: Exit Strategies

Records a realistic (not aspirational) valuation snapshot and its drivers.

**Credentials needed:** None.

assignments.name: valuation_method
assignments.value: 3-5x annual recurring revenue (typical for small automation agencies)

assignments.name: biggest_valuation_risk
assignments.value: Client concentration — over 50% of MRR from one client

assignments.name: one_action_to_increase_valuation
assignments.value: Document and templatize the top 3 client workflows so they're not dependent on undocumented tribal knowledge
